name: Grouper2 - GPO Security Misconfiguration Scanner
description: Grouper2 audits Group Policy Objects for security misconfigurations: passwords in GPP (MS14-025), scheduled tasks with credentials, startup scripts, registry settings, software installation, and other policy weaknesses. Analyzes offline GPO reports or live AD. Essential for finding GPO-based privilege escalation paths.
notes:
=== GENERATE GPO REPORT ===
  gpresult /H gpo_report.html
  # Or with Group Policy Management Console export

=== SCAN GPO REPORT ===
  .\Grouper2.exe -f gpo_report.html
  # Or scan live AD:
  .\Grouper2.exe

=== WHAT IT FINDS ===
  # HIGH SEVERITY:
  - Passwords in Group Policy Preferences (GPP/MS14-025)
  - Scheduled tasks with embedded credentials
  - Startup/logon scripts with credentials
  - Software installation with admin privileges
  # MEDIUM SEVERITY:
  - Weak file/registry permissions in GPO
  - Unrestricted script execution policies
  - Mapped drives with credentials
  - Printer configurations
  # LOW SEVERITY:
  - Informational policy settings
  - Security baselines not met

=== GPP PASSWORD DECRYPTION ===
  # If Grouper2 finds GPP passwords, they can be decrypted:
  # Microsoft published the AES key (MS14-025)
  gpp-decrypt <cpassword_value>
  # Or with CrackMapExec:
  crackmapexec smb <dc_ip> -u <user> -p <pass> -M gpp_autologin
  crackmapexec smb <dc_ip> -u <user> -p <pass> -M gpp_password

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  # SharpGPOAbuse: Exploit writable GPOs (different purpose)
  # PowerView: Get-DomainGPO for GPO enumeration
  # BloodHound: GPO abuse edges

recommended.note: SharpGPOAbuse for exploiting writable GPOs (Grouper2 finds them).

defense.why_it_works: GPOs are accessible to all domain users. Grouper2 parses GPO configurations to find embedded credentials, weak permissions, and other misconfigurations that attackers can exploit.
defense.prerequisites: Domain user access; Grouper2 binary or GPO report.
defense.impact: Discovery of GPP passwords, privilege escalation via GPO misconfigurations.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1615] GPO enumeration queries; SYSVOL access patterns; Grouper2 process execution.
defense.artifacts: Access to SYSVOL/Policies; Grouper2 binary execution; GPO report generation.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=windows EventCode=4688 (NewProcessName="*Grouper2*" OR NewProcessName="*gpresult*")
| table _time, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName has_any ("Grouper2", "gpresult")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
defense.prevention: Remove GPP passwords (MS14-025 patch); audit GPO permissions; restrict SYSVOL access; use LAPS instead of GPP for local admin passwords.

detections.name: GPO enumeration and audit tool execution
detections.logic:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName has_any ("Grouper2", "SharpGPOAbuse")
  or (FileName == "gpresult.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/H")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
detections.false_positives: Legitimate GPO auditing by security teams
detections.tuning: Alert on non-admin users running GPO audit tools
